Class ComponentBlock

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystem.btf.ComponentBlock
Direct Known Subclasses:
MacroBlock, MicroBlock, SecondaryMacroBlock, TopLevelBlock
public abstract class ComponentBlock extends Object
This class defines fields that all component blocks of the linear system must have, and provides the interface they must all implement.
Author:
Jack Bradshaw

    • addCE

      public abstract int addCE(int position, PopulationChangeVector n, int queue) throws BTFMatrixErrorException, InternalErrorException
      Adds the appropriate coefficients of a Convolution Expression to the block
      Parameters:
      position - Carries information on where to insert the equation depending on the context (can be interpreted differently by subclasses)
      n - The Population Change Vector n to which the equation relates
      queue - The queue k to which the equation relates; 1 <= k <= M
      Returns:
      The row at which the equation was inserted
      Throws:
      BTFMatrixErrorException
      InternalErrorException
